text: DSH Calculator 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的计算工具插件，通过注册 calculate 工具并向系统提示加入计算规则，让模型把数值问题交给确定性解析器处理。它支持常见算术、三角与对数函数、变量和最多 50 条表达式的批量计算，也能处理向量与矩阵运算、定积分和数值求导；exact 模式可进行任意精度十进制四则运算、整数幂和阶乘。工具返回结果字符串，表达式错误会给出位置提示。适合需要可靠金额计算、科学计算或矩阵操作的 DSH 用户；无需额外密钥或外部服务。

DSH Calculator adds a `calculate` tool and prompt guidance to DSH Web. It evaluates arithmetic, functions, variables, batches, matrices, integrals, and derivatives. Exact mode supports decimal arithmetic and integer powers. Errors include expression positions. No key or external service is needed.
我想让 DSH 可靠地算出复杂表达式的数值。
有没有办法避免模型心算金额时出现小数误差？
帮我在 DSH 里批量计算一组公式。
需要在对话里做矩阵乘法和求逆。
我想对表达式做定积分或数值求导。
让 DSH 能用变量代入公式并返回计算结果。
I need DSH to evaluate formulas accurately instead of estimating numbers.
Can I calculate money with exact decimal arithmetic in DSH?
DSH Calculator 的功能「批量表达式计算」：calculate 接受单条表达式或最多 50 条表达式的数组，并为每条返回结果或错误信息。
DSH Calculator 的功能「精确十进制计算」：选择 exact 模式后可对十进制数做加减乘除、取余、整数幂和阶乘，输出十进制结果字符串。
DSH Calculator 的功能「矩阵与向量运算」：浮点模式接受矩阵表达式并提供乘法、转置、行列式、求逆和线性方程求解等操作。
DSH Calculator 的功能「数值积分与求导」：浮点模式下可用 integrate 对有限区间积分，也可用 deriv 计算指定点的数值导数。

@qqiqiq/dsh-calculator README · DSH Calculator：A deterministic math tool for [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) agents: it gives the model a
real evaluation engine instead of mental arithmetic, so `0.1 + 0.2` answers `0.3` and money math does
not drift.

The engine is a hand-written tokenizer plus a recursive-descent parser — **no `eval`, no `Function`** —
in one dependency-free file, [`core.js`](./core.js).

@qqiqiq/dsh-calculator README · What it does：- **Operators**: `+ - * / ^ (or **) % !`, parentheses, unary minus, scientific notation `1.5e-3`,
  and the `× ÷ − ×` aliases.
- **Constants**: `pi e tau phi inf`.
- **Functions**: `sqrt cbrt abs sign ceil floor round trunc exp expm1 ln log(x) log(x,base) log2 log10
  sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sinh cosh tanh pow mod gcd lcm min max hypot radians degrees`.
- **Matrices** (float mode): literals `[[1,2],[3,4]]`, row vectors `[1,2,3]`; `+ -` elementwise,
  `*` matrix multiply (`A * [x,y]` treats the vector as a column), scalar `*` and `/`,
  `A^n` integer power (negative = inverse), `A'` transpose; functions
  `det inv transpose trace rank solve(A,b) dot cross norm eye zeros ones shape`.
- **Numeric calculus** (float mode): `integrate(f, x, a, b)` definite integral (adaptive Simpson,
  finite bounds), `deriv(f, x, p)` derivative at a point (central difference + Richardson).
  Results carry ~12 significant digits.
- **Variables**: pass `variables: {"r": 3.5}` and reference `r` in the expression;
  a value may also be a matrix (`number[][]`) or a vector (`number[]`).
- **Batches**: pass an array as `expression`, up to 50 expressions per

@qqiqiq/dsh-calculator README · Install：From the plugin market (search for "DSH Calculator"), or by hand:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/QqiqiQ/dsh-calculator/releases/latest/download/dsh-calculator.tgz
```

Then restart `dsh web`. The bundle registers a single `calculate` tool for every session of the profile,
and appends a short usage rule to the system prompt so the model reaches for the tool instead of
estimating.

@qqiqiq/dsh-calculator README · OpenCode (optional)：The same engine also runs as an [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) custom tool —
[`opencode/tools/calculate.ts`](./opencode/tools/calculate.ts); the tool name comes from the filename.
Copy it together with a copy of `core.js` named `calculator.core.js` into `.opencode/tools/` (project)
or `~/.config/opencode/tools/` (global):

@qqiqiq/dsh-calculator README · OpenCode (optional)：```powershell
$dst = "<your project>\.opencode\tools"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dst
Copy-Item .\opencode\tools\calculate.ts $dst
Copy-Item .\core.js "$dst\calculator.core.js"

Re-copy `calculator.core.js` after upgrading the engine, so both sides stay on the same implementation.
